Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Avicenna was Ismaili based on an unverified SERP/Copilot snippet and did not validate this with authoritative sources. This overreliance on a tangential, likely AI-generated summary led to conflating philosophical influence with denominational affiliation. Proper verification (e.g., checking Wikipedia/Britannica) would show that Avicenna is generally regarded as a Sunni (often Hanafi) or that his affiliation is disputed—not definitively Ismaili.
